about: Market-research benchmark (docs/MARKET_BENCHMARK.md). Run: python -m gtm_crawler.market.benchmark run benchmarks/market/cases.json <out-dir>. Needs GTM__SEARCH__API_KEY and GTM__IDENTITY__USER_AGENT_CONTACT in the environment; never commit them.

cases.question: How large is the European EV charging infrastructure market, how fast is it growing, and what drives and limits it?

cases.question: Bottom-up CRM seat market for Indian MSMEs, cross-checked against collected India CRM market figures.

inputs_checked.customers: 63,388,000 MSMEs = 633.88 lakh 'Total Number of Units', ALL INDIA, NSS 73rd round (July 2015-June 2016): RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 127 (https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/PublicationsView.aspx?id=21517), read 2026-10-21. The other inputs are labelled assumptions.

sizing.market_definition: CRM software seats for Indian MSMEs, per year

customers.name: msmes
customers.rationale: 633.88 lakh units, NSS 73rd round 2015-16 (RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 127); not updated to 2025

units_per_customer.name: seats
units_per_customer.rationale: most MSMEs are micro enterprises with one or two people selling

price_per_unit.name: price
price_per_unit.rationale: entry-level CRM list prices of USD 5-15 per seat per month

sam_filters.name: uses_business_software
sam_filters.rationale: share already using paid business software

penetration.name: penetration
penetration.rationale: three-year share for a new entrant
